Add actual os.path filesystem predicates, not pure path manipulation. Scoped alias extraction also removes a zero-parameter helper, increasing average parameters without adding arguments; retain cohesive IO vocabulary and unchanged thresholds.

Replace scope and usage inference with the specified import-only rule. Removing zero-argument helpers raises the parameter average without adding arguments; module size and complexity fall, with unchanged thresholds.

Prefer the unresolved package spelling for symlinks, with a resolved-name fallback only for an empty dot-root name. One required fallback adds a branch; complexity remains within existing caps and thresholds are unchanged.

Use Path.name on the lexically normalized absolute path, complying with Ruff PTH119 without following symlinks. Only the standard-library import adds size; unchanged thresholds.
